# dist/

Built APKs are copied here by `scripts/build-debug.ps1` / `scripts/build-debug.sh`
(`dist/CactusAI-debug.apk`). APKs are git-ignored: they contain the third-party Needle engine,
whose redistribution terms are not ours to grant. Build one yourself (see the README) or
download the artifact from a GitHub Actions run of your own fork/repository.
